---
title: "Cross-state comparison"
subtitle: "Compare any variable across selected jurisdictions"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

facts      <- tryCatch(tar_read(facts_latest),     error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
per_capita <- tryCatch(tar_read(facts_per_capita), error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
per_gsp    <- tryCatch(tar_read(facts_per_gsp),    error = function(e) tibble::tibble())

status_lbl <- function(b) ifelse(b, "Forecast", "Actual")
```

::: {.callout-note}
Pick **one** variable and one normalisation view. Jurisdictions can
be toggled to bring lines in and out. Default shows net debt in
AUD millions.
:::

```{r}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No facts in the warehouse yet.")
} else {
  long <- bind_rows(
    facts      |> transmute(jurisdiction, variable_id, canonical_label,
                            fiscal_year,
                            status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
                            value  = value_aud_mil,
                            view   = "AUD millions"),
    per_capita |> transmute(jurisdiction, variable_id, canonical_label,
                            fiscal_year,
                            status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
                            value  = value_per_capita_aud,
                            view   = "AUD per capita"),
    per_gsp    |> transmute(jurisdiction, variable_id, canonical_label,
                            fiscal_year,
                            status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
                            value  = value_share_gsp * 100,
                            view   = "% of GSP")
  ) |>
    arrange(jurisdiction, canonical_label, fiscal_year)

  shared <- SharedData$new(long)
  bscols(
    widths = c(3, 9),
    list(
      filter_select("var",  "Variable",      shared, ~canonical_label,
                    multiple = FALSE),
      filter_select("view", "Normalisation", shared, ~view,
                    multiple = FALSE),
      filter_checkbox("jur", "Jurisdictions", shared, ~jurisdiction,
                      inline = TRUE)
    ),
    plot_ly(shared,
            x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value,
            color = ~jurisdiction,
            type  = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            line  = list(width = 2),
            hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y:,.2f}<extra></extra>") |>
      plotly::layout(
        font   = list(family = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", size = 12L),
        legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15),
        margin = list(l = 60L, r = 20L, t = 30L, b = 70L),
        xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
        yaxis  = list(title = "", tickformat = ",")
      )
  )
}
```

## Underlying data

```{r}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No facts to show.")
} else {
  facts |>
    arrange(canonical_label, jurisdiction, fiscal_year) |>
    transmute(
      Jurisdiction = jurisdiction,
      Variable     = canonical_label,
      FY           = fiscal_year,
      `Value (AUD mil)` = round(value_aud_mil),
      Status       = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
      Source       = document_id
    ) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE,
      columns = list(
        `Value (AUD mil)` = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = TRUE))
      )
    )
}
```
